usedFor: Shopify catches the cancellation and SprintOps tracks the work, so “Order Cancelled” can feed “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in SprintOps
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order becomes a task with a title, description and assignee in your sprint or backlog.

watchOut: “Create Task” can set priority and assignees, so decide who owns cancellations before you turn it on.
